Commentary.Commentary: So the target for Singapore is 192 runs. Can they chase this down or will Namibia prevail over them? Do join us in a while for the chase.

Nothing much to speak of the Singapore bowlers. It was a no-show from them. They were thrashed all around the park. But once they managed to break the 70-run stand, the Singapore bowlers staged a small comeback with a flurry of wickets at the fag end of the Namibian innings. They managed to restrict the Namibian onslaught by conceding 42 runs in the last five overs but also picked up four wickets in the process. The star for them was their skipper, Amjad Mahboob who took 3 wickets while conceding 29 runs in the three overs he bowled.

What a batting performance we have seen from Namibia tonight! They started well with both their openers, Stephan Baard and Nikolaas Davin as they raced to 40 in quick time. Then came the Gerhard Erasmus show. He unleashed a flurry of boundaries to send the Singapore bowlers into frenzy. Erasmus was the aggressor in chief as he smashed young Sidhant Singh for 29 runs in one over. Kotze then departed after stitching a 70-run stand with his skipper. But Erasmus continued the merry work and also reached his fifty in the process. Kotze's wicket did give Namibia a scare as a flurry of wickets fell in pursuit of quick runs. But Gerhard Erasmus held fort before falling for a well made 72 runs.

OUT! LBW! A wicket to finish the innings. A slower ball on leg and middle, Green looks for the slog but misses. He is hit on the pads. Mahboob appeals and the umpire raises the finger after thinking for a while. NAMIBIA HAVE 191 RUNS ON THE BOARD.
SIX! No hat-trick there but half a dozen runs for Green and Namibia. Length ball on the pads, Green slogs it over the deep mid-wicket fence. No pressure taken by Green there.
Christi Viljoen is the new man in.

OUT! Erasmus departs now but not before putting his side in a commanding position. Mahboob through will be on a hat-trick next ball. Good length ball outside off, Erasmus looks to heave it over the deep mid-wicket fence but can't get the timing right. He can only send the ball towards Tim David at deep mid-wicket who catches the ball comfortably.
Zane Green is the next batsman in. He will be looking to play a couple of big shots at the end here.

OUT! Caught! Mahboob lands it full around off, Frylinck looks to loft it over the long on fence but the connection is not sweet. The ball goes high in the air. Sunil settles under the ball from long on and takes it comfortably.
Another slower ball and Erasmus misses again. However, he gets a bye this time as Frylinck at the non-striker's end hares for a bye.
Can someone bowl slower ball than that? Smart bowling this one. Lands it just outside off on a good length. Erasmus throws his bat but he is too early in the shot.
Amjad Mahboob to bowl the last over of the innings.
Full toss on the pads, tucked for a couple towards the leg side.
WIDE! This time the umpire calls it wide. Length ball outside leg, Frylinck looks to tuck it towards the leg side but misses.
Length ball on leg, Frylink looks to pull but misses. That looked to be wide as it was down the leg side. The umpire doesn't think so.

Outside off this time, Erasmus lines himself outside the off stump again and slams it through mid-wicket. Just a single as the fielder at long on gets to his right side quickly and fires a sharp throw back to the keeper.
Wide outside off, Erasmus looks to pull at this one but gets a top edge on it. The ball lobs over the keeper behind the wickets towards fine leg but falls in no man's land. The batters take two.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Janak Prakash gets the wicket and Smit has to depart in an attempt to score quick runs. Full and wide outside off, Smit looks to slog it over mid-wicket for a biggie but gets a top edge on it. The ball balloons in the sky and lands near the pitch where Janak runs behind and takes a very good catch, keeping his eyes on the ball.
FOUR! On middle and leg, Smit gets down on one knee and paddles it towards fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Another reverse sweep fetches Erasmus another boundary. This is full and outside off, Erasmus again goes for the reverse sweep and connects. He is playing a top knock out in the middle.
FOUR! Innovation at its best. A full ball outside off, Erasmus gets the ball on the full and reverse sweeps it right of the short third man fence.
Outside off, Erasmus looks to slog again but misses again.
Full ball outside off, Erasmus reaches out to the ball and drives it through point. A couple of runs taken.
Play and a miss. Length ball outside off, Erasmus goes for a slog but misses.

Starts with a poor ball outside off, Erasmus punches this through covers but the mid off fielder does well as he moves to his right to stop. He throws the ball towards the keeper who can't gather the ball cleanly. An overthrow conceded as the ball goes towards fine leg.
Unusual stuff! Aryaman Sunil has come on to bowl the 18th over. It is very rare that we see a fresh bowler come on at the death.
Length and on  middle, Erasmus plays it to mid on for a single.
Length and on off, Smit plays to the point region for a single.
FREE HIT! Smit fails to capitalize on it. He just squeezes this length ball to long on for a couple.
Free hit time!
NO BALL! A full toss above the waist height and Smit just pulls it without any power. The ball goes off the top edge towards fine leg. A couple taken.
Fuller one outside off, Smit just lofts it with ease over the bowler's head . The ball goes to the long off fence for a boundary.
Short one on middle, Erasmus pulls it to mid-wicket for  single.
Fuller one outside off,  pushed to covers for a single.
Janak Prakash is back into the attack. His figures so far, 2-0-14-1.
Another ball on the pads, Smit this time nudges it towards fine leg and takes three before the fielder can return the ball back to the keeper.
Full around off, eased for a single.
On the pads, worked towards mid-wicket.

DROPPED! Another easy chance spilled. This time it is Navin Param who has made a mess of a simple chance. Full length ball on the pads, Erasmus looks to slam it over the mid-wicket fence but gets height more than the distance. Param at deep mid-wicket on settles under the ball but drops it.
On the pads, tucked straight to the fielder.

FOUR! Second consecutive half ton. And an innovative shot to get there. David pitches this on off, Erasmus reverse sweeps it between cover-point. The ball races to the fence. A top knock this one form the skipper.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Poor effort. Another short ball outside off, Smit cuts it nicely through cover-point. The fielder there makes a very Lazy effort and allows the ball to go the fence.
On middle, tucked towards short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished. Short and wide outside off, Erasmus goes back and cuts it between point and short third man. The ball races to the third man fence in no time.
Outside off, punched straight to point.
Full around off, drives towards long on for a single.
Vinoth Baskaran is back into the attack. 2-0-17-0 are his figures so far.
On the pads again, punched towards long on for a run.
On middle, worked behind square leg for an easy run.
Around off, eased through mid off for a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
JJ Smit is the new man in.

OUT! Kotze holes out in search of quick runs. David bowls a flighted ball around off, Kotze this time looks to come to the party. He lofts it straight and over the bowler's head. But he fails to get the distance as  Baskaran at long off takes an easy grab. After a couple of dropped catches finally Singapore fielders hold on to one.
Full around off, worked towards long on for a single.
DROPPED! Full and outside off, Erasmus looks to muscle it over the deep mid-wicket fence but gets a top edge. The ball goes high but Tim David puts it down diving forward. 29 runs from the over.

FOUR! No, no 6 sixes in the over as this one goes for a boundary. Sidhant changes his angle this time and goes around the wicket. Dishes a ball full outside off, Erasmus throws his bat at the ball, gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies through the third man region for a boundary.
SIX! Number 4. Can we have six sixes? The youngster is under the pump. Sidhant goes wide outside off on a good length, Erasmus this time jumps across off stump and pulls it left of long on fielder.
SIX! Make that three in a row. Erasmus is on fire. Good length ball around off and middle, Erasmus this time comes across the off stump just a bit and deposits the ball way over the mid-wicket fence.
SIX! Two in two. Erasmus  is punishing the youngster here. Another ball in the slot, on middle and fuller length, Erasmus slams it over the deep mid-wicket fence again.
SIX! Erasmus into the act now. A full ball on middle, Erasmus deposits it over the deep mid-wicket fence. Terrific timing towards the shorter side of the boundary. 100 up for Namibia.
Sidhant Singh comes on to bowl his final over. 3-0-17-2 are his figures so far.
Swing and a miss! Fires a ball outside off on a fullish length, Kotze throws his bat but misses it altogether.

DROPPED! Poor effort from Baskaran. He had taken a blinder earlier but he now spills an easy chance. Full ball outside off, Kotze looks to loft it over the long off fielder but can not clear him. The fielder gets in position but spills it. The ball roll towards the fence but Baskaran recovers and stops the ball. Two runs taken.
Fires this ball outside off, Kotze leaves it alone. He thinks that the umpire will call it wide but it is inside the tramline.
On the pads this time, clipped towards square leg for a single.
A mild LBW appeal but that was probably pitching outside leg . A ball on leg and middle, Erasmus looks to sweep but misses. An appeal follows but the umpire is not interested.
Starts with a ball on middle, worked towards square leg.
Tim David comes on now.
On the pads, Kotze tucks it behind square for a couple.
SIX! Hammered away! In the slot on a fullish length, Kotze uses the blade to full effect as he slogs it wide of the long on region. Superb shot.
Full outside off, Erasmus drives for a single through mid off.
Full toss this time, only a single as Kotze works it towards deep mid-wicket.
Slower ball on middle, Erasmus looks to heave it down the leg side but is early into the shot. He can only manage a single towards square leg.
On the pads, Erasmus looks to paddle it fine but can only manage an inside edge onto the pads.
Amjad Mahboob is back into the attack. 1-0-12-0 are his figures so far.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Erasmus taps it towards mid on for a single.
Flighted ball on off, Kotze eases a single through covers.
LBW appeal turned down. A full ball around off and middle, Erasmus looks to reverse sweep but misses.
Around off and middle, Kotze tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
This time the bowler gets away. Another poor ball way outside off, Kotze cuts but finds the fielder.
FOUR! He starts with a poor ball outside off, Kotze cuts it through point for a boundary.
Navin Param to bowl now.
Full outside off, Erasmus drives it left of long off fielder to pick a couple on the last ball. Five singles and a two to finish the over.
Full outside off, driven for a single through mid off.
Missed out a chance for a boundary. A poor ball on the pads, Erasmus looks to flick it towards fine leg fence but can't beat the short fine leg  fielder. Just a single there.
Length on the pads, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball around off, driven towards long off for a single.
Shortish length ball on middle, Kotze taps it towards short third man for a single.
Outside off, Erasmus comes down the track to nudge for a single but is hit on the pads.
Full on off, eases for a single through long on this time.
Shortish length ball around off, tapped towards mid on for a single.
Heave and a miss this time. Another ball in the same area as the last ball, Kotze again looks to heave but misses to get any willow. The keeper behind fumbles and allows a bye.
SIX! Massive one! Baskaran lands it full outside off, Kotze gets in the position and slog sweeps it way over the deep mid-wicket fence. What a clean strike that one.
Around off, pushed towards cover for a quick run.
Vinoth Baskaran is back. He gave 8 in his first over.
On the pads, tucked behind square for a single. The skipper is off the mark.
Full ball on the fourth stump line, driven straight to mid off.
Gerhard Erasmus, the skipper is the next man in.

OUT! What a brilliant catch! Wicket number 2 for Sidhant but he should thank Baskaran for that blinder. A wide ball outside off, Williams has room outside off, he drives but finds Baskaran at backward point who gets down in time to pouch the ball inches above the turf.
Landed on middle, tucked towards square leg for a quick single.
Full around of, Williams works it through mid on for an easy run.
Good length ball around off, Kotze taps it through cover-point for a run.

FOUR! Short stuff continues. Prakash goes short once more and Williams looks to pull it over the cow corner fence but unfortunately gets the top edge. Luckily for Williams the ball goes over the keeper and into the third man fence for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Brilliant throw from the fielder at point. Prakash goes short once again and Williams hops inside the crease to play it to the leg side. The ball takes the top edge and lobs to the off side. The fielder at point hares across and scores a bull's eye at the bowler's end. But the umpire is in a great position there and he rules the batsman is well inside with his full length dive.
Length and outside off, Kotze plays it through covers for a single.
Craig Williams is in now.
OUT! CAUGHT! Another one goes down. Prakash goes short and Davin looks to take him on.  He pulls him high but fails to get the distance as the man at deep square leg takes the catch there easily.
Good length and on off, Kotze defends it to point and takes a single.
Length and on off, Kotze plays it to covers.
Janak Prakash is back into the attack for his second over.
Length and on off, Kotze defends it to the off side and takes off for a quick single.
FOUR! Kotze gets off the mark in style. Singh goes full and on the pads, Kotze flicks it to mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Kotze defends it to the off side.
On a length and on middle, Davin flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
JP Kotze is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Fantastic take from the bowler. Singh bowls on a length and on middle, Baard looks to flick it to the leg side but is early into the shot. The ball takes the top edge and lobs high into the night sky. Sidhant Singh settles himself under it and takes an easy grab.
Length and on off, Baard defends it off the back foot.
Sidhant Singh comes on now.
FOUR! Shorter one on middle, Davin pulls it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
Flighted one on middle, Baard flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Davin works it to mid on for a single.
Fuller one pitching outside leg, Baard looks to flick it but fails to lay bat on ball. The ball takes the pads and goes to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Fuller one on pads, Davin pushes it to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Shorter one on middle, Davin pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Navin Param is on now.
SIX! Short ball on middle, Baard pulls it cleanly to mid-wicket for a maximum.
The batsman has punched the ball off the backfoot.
Length and on off, Davin pushes it to the off side for a single.
Length and outside off, Davin looks to go downtown but fails to lay bat on ball.
Length and outside off, baard pushes it to covers for a single.
Amjad Mahboob comes on now
FOUR! Length and on off, Baard drives it through mid off for a boundary.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On the pads, Davin sweeps it through square leg for a couple.
The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
FOUR! Nicely done!  Davin rocks on the back foot and punches the ball through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Davin looks to flick it to the leg side but gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up outside off, Baard looks to go inside out over the off side but gets an inside edge on the pads. The ball goes to the leg side as the batsmen cross for a single.
Vinoth Baskaran to bowl from the other end.
Davin drives this length ball through covers for a couple. 8 from the first over.
Length and on off, Baard punches it to covers for a single.
Short one on middle, Davin pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length going down leg, Davin looks to pull but fails to lay bat on ball. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Length and outside off, Baard drives it through point but doesn't get it from the middle of the bat and hence the ball stops in front of the ropes. Three runs taken. Namibia are off the mark.
On a length and on off, Baard defends it off the back foot.
Length and on off, Baard punches it to the off side.
Time to play! Stephan Baard and Nikolaas Davin walk out to start the proceedings for Namibia. Janak Prakash to start for Singapore with the ball.
Pitch report - Good pitch with some scarce grass on it. The surface might slow down a bit favoring the spinners later on.

Grehard Erasmus, Namibia skipper says that they haven't thought of any formula at the moment. Says that the guys have got the momentum from the last three games. On the surface, he adds that it's a great surface and thinks that this ground is tailor-made for them.

Amjad Mahboob, Singapore skipper says that he will field first. Tells that bowling first gives them the opportunity to restrict the opposition and then chase it down quickly. States that the net run-rate is important and hence the decision of bowling first.

Singapore (Playing XI) - Surendran Chandramohan, Rohan Rangarajan, Tim David, Aritra Dutta, Manpreet Singh(WK), Navin Param, Janak Prakash, Vinoth Baskaran, Amjad Mahboob(C), Sidhant Singh, Aryaman Sunil
Namibia (Playing XI) - Stephan Baard, Niko Davin, JP Kotze, Zane Green(WK), Gerhard Erasmus(C), JJ Smit, Craig Williams, Christi Viljoen, Jan Frylinck, Bernard Scholtz, Ben Shikongo
Toss - It's time for the flip of the coin. Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Singapore. SINGAPORE WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO FIELD!

Welcome to the match 37th of the ICC World T20 Qualifiers. Today Namibia take on Singapore. Namibia with six points would look to win today's encounter and move a step closer to qualification. Namibia are high on confidence after thrashing Kenya in their last fixture. Whereas, Singapore are coming on the back of a loss against Papua New Guinea and would look to keep their hopes of qualifying alive with a win over the African nation. Toss and teams in a while.
